verdict.rationale: Recruitee exposes a general REST API (candidates, offers, departments, locations) and webhooks that could be used to pull data out, and lists a generic 'Reporting & Insights' feature, but there is no documented reporting-specific API, scheduled export mechanism, or BI connector (e.g., to Looker/Tableau/warehouse) in the evidence. missing for 10: dedicated reporting/analytics API endpoints, scheduled export/BI connector docs, warehouse integration examples.
